item.title: [compression] CompressionStream and DecompressionStream supports "brotli" codec in Safari 18.4 and later
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DecompressionStream
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CompressionStream

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Browser Compatibility

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

Incomplete. Safari added support for "brotli" compression and decompression with CompressionStream and DecompressionStream in 18.4.

What did you expect to see?

There should be another line item in the table for "brotli" compression, showing it available in Safari 18.4 and later.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

https://developer.apple.com/documentation/safari-release-notes/safari-18_4-release-notes#Web-API

Sample code, generated by GPT-o3:
brotli-CompressionStream.html.txt

Do you have anything more you want to share?

item.title: [file-system-access] Broken example code for DataTransferItem.getAsFileSystemHandle()
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DataTransferItem/getAsFileSystemHandle

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Examples

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The "Return value" section states the method must be "accessed in the dragstart or drop event handlers". However, the example code uses await, meaning that if more than one item is dropped, the second item's getAsFileSystemHandle will not be invoked "during" the event handler and will not return a file handle.

What did you expect to see?

The example code should be updated so it accesses the items correctly during the event handler

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response

item.title: [periodic-background-sync] periodicSync needs "periodic-background-sync" permission
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PeriodicSyncManager/register

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Exceptions

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

In chromium browsers, this feature also requires the "periodic-background-sync" permission, which throws an error if not obtained: "Permission denied. "

This permission is not available through code, and will only be granted if the user installs the website (with PWA enabled) on their computer.

I haven't tested it in other browsers, at least in edge and Chrome.

What did you expect to see?

I would like to add a description of the error to the error list.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

https://developer.chrome.com/docs/capabilities/periodic-background-sync#try_it

Google has mentioned here that the feature is available only after installing the app.

You can determine if you have permissions using this code: navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'periodic-background-sync' }).

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
